title: Riding to the Lake
lines: Kate was taking her bike to the lake.
Mom was riding just behind her.
The sun was shining on the long road.
Kate was smiling. This was the best ride.
She waved at a man raking his yard.
Then a cat came sliding out from a shed.
Kate was making a big turn at the time.
The bike slid. Kate was not smiling.
She got a foot down and saved it.
But now the bike made a bad sound.
Kate got off and looked at the chain.
It had come off while she was sliding.
She held the chain and gave it a pull.
It slipped, and her hands went black with dirt.
"Hold the bike up for me," Kate said.
Mom held it up while Kate sat down.
This time she set the chain on with both hands.
Then she made it go round and round.
The chain went on and the bike was fine.
Mom said, "You saved that ride, Kate."
Kate was smiling all the way to the lake.

questions.ask: What came out from the shed?
questions.listenFor: A cat, sliding. If they say dog, have them go back and look.

questions.ask: What did Kate try first with the chain, and did it work?
questions.listenFor: She held it and gave it a pull. It slipped and made her hands black.

questions.ask: What do you think Kate will do next time she sees a cat?
questions.listenFor: Any sensible answer. You want them to use what the story showed, not just guess.
